chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, was asked about a pregnant woman whom her husband divorces, then takes back, then divorces again, then takes back, then divorces a third time, and he said:
She has become separated from him, and she is not permissible for him until she marries another husband.

key_terms.لَا تَحِلُّ لَهُ: she is not lawful for him
key_terms.يُرَاجِعُهَا: he takes her back during revocable divorce

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a pregnant woman is divorced three times with revocations in between?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning a pregnant woman who is divorced and taken back repeatedly until the third divorce. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that after the third divorce she is fully separated from her husband and does not become lawful for him again until she marries another husband.
